The '''1983 FA Charity Shield''' was the 61st [[FA Community Shield|FA Charity Shield]], an annual [[association football|football]] match played between the winners of the previous season's [[Football League First Division|First Division]] and [[FA Cup]] competitions. The match was played on 20 August 1983 at [[Wembley Stadium (1923)|Wembley Stadium]] and contested by [[Liverpool F.C.|Liverpool]], who had won the [[1982–83 Football League#First Division|1982–83 First Division]], and [[Manchester United F.C.|Manchester United]], who had won the [[1982–83 FA Cup]]. Manchester United won 2–0 with a brace from captain [[Bryan Robson]]. It was Liverpool's first competitive game under the management of [[Joe Fagan]], who had been promoted from the coaching staff to replace the retiring [[Bob Paisley]].
